newsitem.title: USA: Dynamics to comment on new WHX bid.
newsitem.headline: Dynamics to comment on new WHX bid.

text.p: Dynamics Corp of America said Wednesday it plans to comment on or before April 14 on the sweetened $45-a-share unsolicited takeover bid from WHX Corp.
Henry Kensing, vice president and general counsel of the Greenwich, Conn.-based diversified electronics components maker, said Dynamics' board would discuss the offer.
"We have until Monday to make a comment on the bid," Kensing said, citing regulations by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
"We are not going to have a comment at this time. We plan to do that on or before Monday," he said.
Previously, Dynamics called WHX's original $40-a-share takeover offer "totally inadequate."
